scripts.build: npm run build -w @extreme-hanafuda/game-core && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-extreme-hanafuda --only auth,firestore "vitest run tests/rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-extreme-hanafuda --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run tests/emulators.test.ts"
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && firebase deploy --project hanahuda-adf91 --only functions,firestore,hosting
